page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7se.large is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture utilizing a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled, resulting in 2 threads per core. It is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Local storage is not bundled, meaning the instance relies entirely on external network storage. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 1 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate a divergence between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core execution, such as stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core scores, falls within the average range. However, due to the low core count, multi-core benchmarks, including stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU scores, rank in the bottom 10 percent. Memory bandwidth tests for both read and write operations also register in the bottom 10 percent, while Passmark memory scores are weak. Cryptographic and integer operations benefit from hardware-accelerated instruction sets like AES, VAES, SHA_NI, and AVX-512.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance provides dedicated CPU resources and a high memory-to-core ratio without the overhead of local storage or high-speed networking. It is designed for memory-bound workloads that do not require massive parallel processing power. Suitable workloads include small-scale database hosting, caching layers, lightweight web serving, and memory-intensive utility applications that run efficiently within a dual-vCPU envelope.
